response.changelog:
What's New in Pixel OS v2.1.15:
• Real-Time Bidirectional Auto-Brightness & Persistent Room Pattern Learning: Fixed vendor AlsCorrection hysteresis deadlock and [10, 71.43] lux indoor freeze, eliminated <100ms ON_CHANGE ALS event drops and IAreaCapture transient drops in multihal, prevented PhysicalMappingStrategy from wiping learned curves back to default on power updates, and removed ShortTermModel double-warping across QS & Settings sliders.
• Strict Home-Screen-Only Double-Tap Lock: Double-tap to lock triggers exclusively on the unlocked Home Screen wallpaper and is strictly blocked while typing (keyboard open), inside any app, on the status bar, or on the lock screen.
• Goodix G3 Optical UDFPS Calibration Auto-Repair: DT_NEEDED calibration shim (libgf_cali_shim.so) + expanded tee_202504 SFS SELinux rules on /mnt/vendor/persist/data/sfs so fingerprint scanning and enrollment initialize cleanly.
• Calibrated Dark-Room Minimum Brightness & 15s Screen Timeout: 2.0-nit to 450-nit 10-bit Samsung AMOLED curve and reliable 15-second screen-off sleep even while USB-plugged.
• Fixed Banking & UPI Apps (Paytm, PhonePe & Google Pay) & Duplicate Camera App Icon alongside built-in KernelSU-Next v1.0.9.
• 60fps Google Pixel OLED Boot Animation & Wi-Fi Hotspot Stability.
